title: Privilege escalation via mass assignment — role parameter
desc: User update endpoint accepted role parameter from client. Setting role:admin elevated privileges.
steps:
1. Capture profile update request
2. Add role:admin to JSON body
3. Submit — account now has admin role

title: Privilege escalation via group owner IDOR
desc: Group membership update endpoint lacked authorization. Any member could promote themselves to owner.
steps:
1. Find group membership update endpoint
2. Change access_level to 50 (owner)
3. Submit — now group owner

title: Escalate to program admin via invitation token reuse
desc: Program admin invitation tokens were single-use but not invalidated after use. Reusing token granted admin access.
steps:
1. Obtain an admin invitation token (e.g. from email)
2. Use token to join as admin
3. Reuse same token with different account — also gets admin

title: Admin panel access via forced browsing
desc: Admin panel at /admin was not linked from UI but accessible. No role check on admin routes.
steps:
1. Enumerate common admin paths: /admin, /dashboard/admin, /manage
2. Access admin panel with regular user session
3. Full admin functionality available

title: Escalate to support agent via parameter pollution
desc: Support ticket assignment endpoint accepted agent_id parameter. Regular users could assign tickets to themselves, gaining agent-level access.
steps:
1. Submit support ticket
2. Intercept ticket creation request
3. Add agent_id: your_user_id
4. Ticket assigned to you — agent panel accessible
